# `a5`

Helper: `a5({ title, draft, rows, items, note, signDate, signRole, signName })`  
Kit (`src/ui`): kit gap (print sheet) · status: kit gap  
App (KMP `core:ui`): `A5PrintPreviewScreen` (feature:orders screen)

## Anatomy

Paper sheet 148 x 210: header with logo, title, draft stamp, fields grid, items, note, signature block.

## Variants

- Prescription, consultation form (content by `rows`, `items`)

## States

- Static: it has no hover, focus or disabled state of its own

## Tokens

plate, line-strong, ink, heading, link, warning (draft stamp)

## Do

- Two per row in `grid(2, ...)`
- Stays white in dark mode

## Don't

- Do not use it as a screen layout

## Web (1440 and 1920)

Web-only print sheet.

## Mobile (390)

Not drawn at 390.

## Rules (design-specs/web/BLOCKS.md)

**web-only.** Portrait paper (148 × 210), 2 per row in a `grid(2, ...)`
